correctness.rationale: For complex symmetric \(Q\), a repeated characteristic root yields an isotropic eigenvector either by a 2D eigenspace or a length-two Jordan chain. Conversely any isotropic eigenvector forces a nontrivial Jordan chain using the image/kernel orthogonal-complement identity if the root were simple. Evaluation onto \(V/\mathbf Cv\) is fiberwise surjective; its kernel is a smooth rank-\(N-n+1\) vector bundle over the smooth rational quadric. The projection is proper onto exactly the characteristic discriminant. The explicit symmetric nilpotent \(2\times2\) block with distinct complementary eigenvalues proves generically unique isotropic eigenline, hence birationality. The perturbation of that block has first-order nonzero discriminant and therefore proves irreducibility of the reduced polynomial of degree \(n(n-1)\). The size-two polynomial factors into two distinct hyperplanes in the three-dimensional parameter space. Exact finite checker independently confirms the local computations and surjectivity for \(3\le n\le8\), without claiming infinite computation.

originality.rationale: The initiating 2026 open-access source gives the common ED discriminant as a repeated-root SET; this result adds an explicit globally smooth vector-bundle incidence resolution, a generically unique null eigenline, a rational function field and irreducible reduced polynomial. The closest older real-symmetric degeneracy literature studies a different codimension-two real variety and does not imply a complex hypersurface resolution. Five focused indexed searches and relevant primary full-text comparisons found no covering statement. Residual risk of older equivalent invariant-theoretic eigenvector-incidence descriptions is recorded and does not arise as a decisive source contradiction.
residual_risks: A classical equivalent conormal/incidence construction may be buried in matrix invariant theory or representation theory and was not found in the searches.
The Domokos paper was not inspected beyond its abstract, which is insufficient to exclude every possible auxiliary theorem.
Indexed-search absence is not a proof of mathematical novelty.

value.rationale: The original projection-Grassmannian ED-discriminant theorem is a set equality. Its geometry and rationality as a complex affine parameter variety are natural information needed for ED singularity analysis. The proper smooth rational model is uniform for all matrix dimensions \(n\ge3\) and all Grassmannian ranks, with an explicit vector-bundle rank, exact reduced polynomial degree and genuine reducible boundary at \(n=2\). It is a structural geometric theorem rather than a textbook substitution or a finite isolated numerical statistic; no claims about small/crepant resolutions, singular scheme or further ED formulas are made.
